executionScope.purpose: Review inherited performance evidence and separate the current dirty runtime variant from an ignored reference snapshot before any new measurement.

historicalPhase4Run.closureReproducedInterpretation: Reproduction flag retained as historical evidence; it is not causal proof.

findingReview.observation: Broad app-state hydration and store fan-out remain a high static risk candidate; inherited performance records do not identify a causal loader or consumer boundary.
findingReview.missingProof: At least three matching valid authenticated traces must connect the broad hydration path to the missed task budget and identify the exact loader/consumer path.
findingReview.requiredClosureEvidence: Three or more matching valid samples/traces with request, body-finish, parse, render, and task-ready boundaries plus exact file/function attribution.

findingReview.observation: Inbox, messaging, and AI Chat refresh paths remain a background-overlap candidate; historical failures do not isolate overlap from normal route/render work.
findingReview.missingProof: At least three matched valid traces must show overlapping refresh work and a repeatable task-ready or interaction delta without losing freshness behavior.
findingReview.requiredClosureEvidence: A controlled natural-refresh versus diagnostic-pause comparison with request overlap/count, long-task, task-ready, and freshness checks.

findingReview.observation: The eager dashboard import and panel/render graph remains a bundle and main-thread candidate; no measured panel or import contribution was established by inherited evidence.
findingReview.missingProof: At least three matching valid traces must identify the heavy bundle, panel, or render path and its contribution to interaction or readiness delay.
findingReview.requiredClosureEvidence: Main-thread parse/evaluate, long-task, layout, paint, panel, and task-ready timing with exact path attribution; no speculative split is accepted as proof.

findingReview.observation: AI Chat authentication and required-read coverage is a measurement-gate gap, not a runtime root-cause claim; a valid sample requires the authenticated conversation-list 2xx/body-finish and workspace-ready boundary.
findingReview.missingProof: The required authenticated AI Chat read and workspace selector must be present in valid samples; 401, timeout, or missing readiness remains a measurement/auth/store failure class.
findingReview.requiredClosureEvidence: Authenticated AI Chat samples with a 2xx conversation-list response, body-finish, and required workspace selector, with auth failure, response, parse, and render outcomes separated.

findingReview.observation: The warm AI Chat journey remains a measured historical candidate, but its candidate surface and causal layer are still unassigned; inherited slow samples cannot be treated as a fix or cause.
findingReview.missingProof: At least three valid authenticated traces must separate auth, store, network, parse, render, and polling timing and map the result to exact files/functions.
findingReview.requiredClosureEvidence: A corrected warm-session journey with valid authenticated reads, task-ready, event-to-paint, render, and polling boundaries plus exact attribution.
